tasks.short: Write and submit production project bids.

steps.what: Read the project tender, clarify deliverables and capture submission requirements and constraints
outputs: captured bid requirements and open questions

steps.what: Decide the proposed creative approach, delivery plan and production commitments
inputs: captured bid requirements and open questions
outputs: producer's proposed approach and delivery commitments

steps.what: Prepare bid costs and schedule from checked quantities, rates, availability and contingency decisions
inputs: producer's proposed approach and delivery commitments
existing rate cards and actual quotations
outputs: checked bid cost and schedule tables

steps.what: Write the project proposal using native bid sections and a bounded narrative draft from the producer's commitments
inputs: producer's proposed approach and delivery commitments
checked bid cost and schedule tables
captured bid requirements and open questions
outputs: complete proposed bid package and submission destination

loop.purpose: Draft bid narrative around explicit production commitments
loop.input: Tender requirements, chosen approach, verified costs and schedule
loop.output: Reviewable proposal with requirement and source references
loop.check: Producer checks promised scope, dates, exclusions and prices against actual decisions and tender meaning
loop.stop: Unsupported promise blocks completion; two drafting passes then manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates and exact tables handle standard content; project-specific explanatory prose needs writing.

steps.what: Review and approve the complete final proposal, prices, attachments and exact submission recipient
inputs: complete proposed bid package and submission destination

steps.what: Submit the exact approved proposal to bid on the client's project contract and check the submission receipt

tasks.design: Configure native production budget and schedule fields in {OTHER}, the production planning suite, and proposal templates in {DOCS} before custom code. The producer chooses the approach and captures actual rates and quantities; deterministic tables and a bounded narrative loop prepare the bid, followed by full commitment and claim review. A distinct manual submission through {EMAIL} or {PARTNER_PORTAL} uses only the approved final package, with any change requiring renewed approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Costs, schedules and explanatory proposal prose are assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native production planning and controlled draft assistance can reuse explicit bid decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Winning creative approach, realistic commitments and acceptable contractual risk.
tasks.human_edge: Own what the production can actually deliver.

ambition.what: Prepare current project bids with less repeated assembly.

tasks.altitude: Creative and commercial commitments remain with the producer.

reach.learn: Trace quantities, rates and contingency assumptions to the same bid tables.

evidence.claim: Production planning tools and document templates can reuse cost and schedule fields; language models can draft prose from explicit commitments.

assumptions: s1 captures deliverables, deadline, submission format and destination. s3 includes manual quantity, rate and quotation checking; no complete priced brief is assumed.
s4 includes commitment-fidelity checking; s5 reviews the entire final package. Submission time remains full because client requirements vary.
The producer has delegated bid authority; any additional organizational authorization must be separately counted where required.
unknowns: Native budget template coverage and actual bid authorization rules.
research_questions: Does draft preparation save time after checking every production promise?

already_counted.description: Narrative commitment checks and final bid review.

incremental.description: Maintain bid templates, rate-field mappings and draft checks.

approvals.approved_version: approved bid version including exact proposal, costs, attachments and client submission destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Six budget/schedule preparation and twelve proposal drafting hours saved, less two upkeep. Low case assumes native reuse already exists and drafting checks remove all additional gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compose and edit scripts or provide story outlines.

steps.what: Develop the story premise, character intentions and creative outline for the production
inputs: permitted source material and production constraints

steps.what: Compose scripts or story outlines in the producer's own creative voice
Edit the script or outline creatively and apply native scene-heading, numbering and revision formatting
outputs: complete proposed script or story outline and writer recipient

steps.what: Approve the complete final script or outline revision and named screenwriter recipient
inputs: complete proposed script or story outline and writer recipient

steps.what: Commit the approved script or outline revision to the internal production document record
Send the approved outline or script revision to the named external screenwriter

tasks.design: Configure native revision and formatting features in {OTHER}, the screenwriting editor, linked to controlled {DOCS}. Original composition and creative editing remain human; only scene numbering, revision formatting and separately approved filing and {EMAIL} handoff change. The complete final revision exists before approval, edits or recipient changes cancel approval, and no model supplies plot, dialogue or purported source material.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual revision formatting and moving the correct script version to writers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native screenplay formatting and controlled document routing can remove mechanical handling.
tasks.still_hard: Story, character, dramatic structure and working with writers.
tasks.human_edge: Create and edit with a deliberate artistic point of view.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical work around original script development.

tasks.altitude: Creative authorship and editing remain the producer's work.

reach.learn: Work from the exact approved outline and revision.

evidence.claim: Screenwriting editors support native scene numbering, revision formatting and document export.

assumptions: The producer captures creative intent in s1 and authors content in s2. s3's reduction covers mechanical formatting only; creative edit time remains full.
This case provides the outline to an external screenwriter; internal recipients require internal send authority.
No missing creative input is assumed to be prepared by another role.
research_questions: Which revision tasks remain mechanical after the editor's native features are enabled?

already_counted.description: Creative editing, revision formatting and final review remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain revision export and recipient routing settings.

approvals.approved_version: approved script or outline version including revision identifier and internal record target
approved script or outline version including exact document and external screenwriter recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: three mechanical script-formatting and five actual send-handling hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native formatting and routing leave only enough benefit to cover upkeep. Same-document-record commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Cut and edit recordings into desired sequences.

steps.what: Import and organize source film or tape transfers using existing clip identifiers, timecodes and native synchronization tools
outputs: organized and checked editing source set

steps.what: Select takes and decide the desired sequence, pacing and dramatic meaning
inputs: organized and checked editing source set

steps.what: Cut and edit film or tape to integrate component parts into desired sequences using native linked-media and multicamera editing
inputs: organized and checked editing source set

steps.what: Review the actual assembled sequence for continuity, sound, pacing and intended meaning and make corrections
Approve the complete final sequence and internal edit-revision destination
Commit the approved sequence revision and its source references to the internal production edit record

tasks.design: Configure native ingest presets, linked audio/video and multicamera functions in {OTHER}, the nonlinear editing and media-asset system. The producer still chooses takes, cuts creatively and reviews the actual result; native linked operations reduce repetitive synchronization and linked track handling only. After the complete sequence exists, a separate approved action commits its internal revision, edits void approval, and no public distribution or render-runtime saving is claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated clip organization and linked track manipulation interrupt creative editing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native synchronization and linked-media editing can reduce mechanical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Pacing, continuity and the meaning created by juxtaposition.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the actual sequence as an audience experiences it.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical editing operations in current productions.

reach.learn: Use the same source-linked revision and creative decisions.

evidence.claim: Nonlinear editors provide native media organization, synchronization and linked-track or multicamera operations.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not observed. Digital editing or digitized tape is the chosen workflow case.
Camera and sound systems produce raw clips and timecodes; s1 includes checking and manual correction where metadata or synchronization fails.
s3's reduction covers repeated linked operations, not creative decisions; review remains full.
No existing render, ingest or export runtime is counted as human savings.
unknowns: How much native linked-media functionality is already used.
research_questions: Which repeated track operations remain after configuring the current editor?

already_counted.description: Actual sequence review and final revision approval.

incremental.description: Maintain ingest presets and check linked-media behavior after project changes.

approvals.approved_version: approved sequence version including exact edit, linked sources and internal revision target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: six source-organisation and eight mechanical editing hours saved less two upkeep. Low: native edit features remove most new benefit. Same-edit-record revision commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write and edit news stories from reporters' information.

steps.what: Retrieve reporters' source notes, actual updates and authorized quotations for the news story
inputs: existing reporter submissions and source records

steps.what: Judge news relevance, resolve conflicting accounts with reporters and choose the justified story structure
outputs: verified story findings and chosen structure

steps.what: Write the news story from information collected by reporters using a bounded prose draft
inputs: verified story findings and chosen structure
outputs: draft news story with source references

loop.purpose: Draft story prose from verified reporter evidence
loop.input: Permitted source facts, exact quotations and the chosen structure
loop.check: Producer verifies every claim's meaning, attribution, caveat and quotation against original reporting
loop.stop: Unresolved or invented claim blocks completion; two edits then manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native story templates supply structure, but new prose needs writing; source and editorial judgement remain human.

steps.what: Edit and verify the complete news story for meaning, accuracy, attribution and production suitability
inputs: draft news story with source references

steps.what: Approve the complete final story for internal production staging
Commit the approved final story to the internal newsroom production staging record

tasks.design: Configure native reporter-submission views and story templates in {OTHER}, the newsroom production system, with evidence in {DOCS}. The producer resolves gaps and sets structure, then a bounded loop drafts permitted verified material while human editing checks claim meaning and source fidelity. A separate final-version approval gates internal staging; changes void it, confidential sources stay outside the model, and public broadcast or publication requires the later newsroom release process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reporter evidence is repeatedly gathered and rewritten into production copy.
tasks.enabler_now: Native submission views and bounded drafting can reuse explicit verified findings.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting reports and misleading simplification under deadline.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the story and hold it to actual reporting evidence.

ambition.what: Prepare current news production copy with less draft administration.

tasks.altitude: Editorial judgement and source verification remain human.

reach.learn: Preserve exact attribution, quotations and unresolved claims in normal submissions.

evidence.claim: Native newsroom views and bounded prose drafting can support source-linked story preparation; task-specific time saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Reporters produce normal notes and source records, with no new structured reporting burden. s1 includes reading and gap detection; s2 captures verified claim, attribution, exact quotation, caveat and structure manually where necessary.
s3 includes draft meaning checks; s4 and s5 retain full final editing and approval.
The workflow ends with written production copy internally staged; no public release saving is claimed.
unknowns: Existing submission-view coverage and permitted model inputs.
research_questions: Does bounded drafting save preparation time after complete editorial checks?

already_counted.description: Complete final story editing and staging approval.

incremental.description: Maintain permitted-input rules and check recurrent drafting errors.

approvals.approved_version: approved news staging version including complete final text and production staging destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: eight retrieval and10.5 news-draft hours saved less two upkeep. Low: native views already work and drafts need full rewriting. Same-newsroom-record staging retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Production and editorial judgement supported by native planning, revision and media tools.
reach: Writers, production accountants, editors and reporters share exact approved artifacts.
skills_to_grow: Native script and media revision controls
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated assembly and mechanical handling while retaining creative and editorial decisions.
